title: 自改进冻结门训练（SIFT）：动态文档分类器
summary: 提出SIFT动态分类器服务，通过廉价CPU管线（SPLADE+LightGBM）处理大部分分类，仅将低置信度样本升级至LLM裁判，裁判结果回注训练集，实现低成本持续自改进。采用冻结门机制（关键标签F1回归检查+冻结黄金回归集）确保安全，避免静默退化。
summary_en: SIFT is a dynamic classifier that uses a cheap CPU pipeline (SPLADE+LightGBM) for most classifications, escalating only low-confidence cases to an LLM judge. Judge verdicts are fed back to improve the cheap model, reducing escalation rate and growing the corpus from production traffic. A frozen-gate mechanism ensures safety against silent regression.
